chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.prompt:
ku 50 mL ye 0.2 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ kunowedzerwa 0.1 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$, uye huwandu hwose hwema ion (mmol) mu solution hunonyorwa. Mvura haiverengwi sema ion, uye $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ chete ndiyo inoitika.
Vhoriyamu yeNaOH(aq) yakawedzerwa (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Ma ion ose (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Kana 150 mL yeNaOH(aq) yawedzerwa, ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo reshiyo yenhamba $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ musanganiswa uye (ma ion ose mushure mekusanganisa) / (ma ion ose ekutanga mu 50 mL yeHCl(aq) pamwe ne 150 mL yeNaOH(aq)), nenzira iyoyo? (Siya autoionization yemvura.)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Kuverenga tafura. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (neutralization point). Kusvikira panguva iyoyo H+ imwe neimwe inotsiviwa neNa+, saka huwandu hwose hunogara hwakaenzana.
Nhanho 2: Pa 150 mL NaOH inopa Na+ 15 mmol neOH- 15 mmol. 10 mmol yeOH- inopindura ne 10 mmol yeH+, ichisiya OH- 5 mmol. Ma ion: Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5, reshiyo 3 : 2 : 1, huwandu hwose 30 mmol.
Nhanho 3: Ma ion pamberi pekusanganisa = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Reshiyo = 30/50 = 3/5.
Pindura: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: OH- = 15 inonyima neutralization; 5/3 inopesanisa reshiyo; 3/4 inorevera ma ion ekutanga se 40.)

chemistry-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
